installed_failed_attempts.result: First installed startup reached title; independent probe omitted CommonBlockDeliveryChecks and failed with NoClassDefFoundError. Main mod JAR was intact.

After packaging repair, installed title check failed on mutually exclusive counting. Three BasicMachineBlock identities also occur in the named source block map; independent sets now verified, all1311 paths checked and missing identities printed.

Forge passed; Neo reached title then failed because probe supplied static registry lookup as TooltipContext, without data-pack enchantment registry. Use native TooltipContext.EMPTY at title, as existing installed material probe does. Only Neo retried.

After context repair all1311 named paths and251 native basic machines (overlap4) passed; representative ceramic crucible retained an old Pickaxe row identical to its new common harvest row. Fixed actual main mod tooltip cleanup in BOTH loaders; also removed analogous legacy wire harvest row. Rebuilt ordinary pair and retried both clients; did not change harvest policy, recipes, quantities or save data.

New Forge ordinary package passed. Neo all source identities, class representatives, covers and default storage tooltips passed, then four saved mass-template name checks failed because EMPTY has no item registry. For those four only, call actual BlockItem.appendHoverText with real built-in item lookup. Full tooltip event checks retain EMPTY. This is a probe-only context correction; new ordinary pair reused unchanged and only Neo retried.

repair_scope: Initial three repairs affected independent probe/build/launcher only. Fourth removes actual legacy crucible/wire harvest rows in both native common handlers; ordinary pair rebuilt/reverified and both installed clients retried. Fifth adjusts only four Neo saved-name probe calls to real native BlockItem.appendHoverText with built-in item lookup, retaining full default tooltip event checks; ordinary pair reused, Neo only retried. Unchanged harvest policy, material data, recipes, saves and language; passed world suite not repeated.
recorder_diagnostics: Initial receipt-only recording rejected an old installed launch log as UTF-8. Check its ASCII failure marker in original bytes instead; hashes/raw log preserved, no runtime rerun or source change.
Receipt loop temporarily shadowed main build elapsed string; corrected from original successful build log to1m9s before committing. Runtime evidence unchanged.
warnings: Existing model/leaf/animation/shader/Java warnings remain in logs; no new guarantee that every legacy model warning is resolved.
limitations: Title-screen native tooltip events/methods establish installed item metadata, not player hover or complete machine operation. Four Neo saved mass-template name checks call actual BlockItem.appendHoverText with built-in item lookup; a world registry is not fabricated and this does not establish world context rendering.
Finite native worlds cover six crafting representatives and two harvest cases per platform; no full naturally scheduled survival chain.
Saving dimensions on exit is not an independent saved-world restart. Historical saves and ordinary dedicated server not newly accepted here.
Original locker families, wood shelf quantities, saved capacity overrides/blinking colour and remaining block tooltip/material gaps remain.
Pair does not imply the entire port goal complete; later batches need separate acceptance.
publication: Local Git and stable paired copies only; no remote push or PR
